name: Python & General Scripting
description: Configured for idiomatic Python 3.10+ development with pytest, ruff/black formatting, and explicit type hints.
conventions: Adhere to PEP 8 style with standard 4-space indentation.
Add type annotations to all public functions, classes, and return signatures.
Use pytest for all automated tests; isolate disk operations with tmp_path.
Avoid bare except clauses; catch specific exceptions with diagnostic logging.
